cd.CD0332: How do I change my profile?
cd.CD0333: In Profile → Settings, tap 'Delete account'. Your data is held for 30 days before permanent deletion, in line with Korean privacy law (PIPA).
cd.CD0334: How do I delete my account?

cd.CD0346: B4K is a K-culture travel discovery platform for foreign tourists visiting Korea. Explore K-Pop venues, K-Drama filming locations, K-Beauty spots, and K-Culture landmarks on an interactive map, then build your own trip plan.
cd.CD0348: Sign up with your email and a password, or continue with Google, Apple, or Microsoft. There is no separate onboarding — once you sign up you land straight on the Home page.
cd.CD0349: How do I create an account?
cd.CD0350: B4K is available in Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Thai, and Brazilian Portuguese. You can change your language anytime in Profile settings.
cd.CD0353: B4K is a K-culture travel discovery platform for foreign tourists visiting Korea. Find K-Pop venues, K-Drama filming locations, beauty spots, and more — then build your own itinerary.
cd.CD0355: You can explore the map without an account. Saving places, creating itineraries, and joining the leaderboard require signing in with Google.
cd.CD0356: Do I need an account to use B4K?
cd.CD0357: B4K is available in Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Thai, and Portuguese (Brazil).
cd.CD0360: Tap any pin on the map to open the place panel, then tap the bookmark icon to save it. Saved places appear in your Saved tab.
cd.CD0361: How do I save a place?
cd.CD0362: Open a place on the map and tap 'Add to plan' in the panel. You can add multiple stops, reorder them, and let B4K calculate the best route.
cd.CD0363: How do I build an itinerary?
cd.CD0365: Open a place on the map and add it to your plan. Add stops, reorder them, and each leg shows an estimated travel time. When you are happy with it, tap Save Plan. You can also ask the AI assistant to draft a plan for you.
cd.CD0366: How do I create a trip plan?
cd.CD0367: Yes. You can explore the map and build a plan as a guest — your draft is kept in your browser so it survives a refresh. You only need to sign in when you tap Save Plan, and your draft moves to your account automatically.
cd.CD0368: Can I use B4K without an account?
cd.CD0369: A single plan can hold up to 40 stops. Once you reach the limit the Add button is disabled and a message lets you know. There is no in-app payment — partner plans simply link out to the partner's website.
cd.CD0370: Is there a limit on how many stops a plan can have?
cd.CD0372: Open any place from the map and tap the bookmark icon. Saved places appear in your Saved tab, where you can browse them all in one list.
cd.CD0373: How do I save a place?
cd.CD0374: Folders let you organize your saved places into single-level groups — for example one folder per city or per interest. Folders are for saved places only; saved plans stay in a single flat list.
cd.CD0376: In the Saved tab, select the places you want with the checkboxes, then choose Generate plan. B4K arranges them into a suggested route and opens the new plan so you can fine-tune it.
cd.CD0377: How do I generate a plan from saved places?
